message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that’s carried out roughly every seven years as part of its routine maintenance. In practice, the actual painting work—applying fresh coats of protective paint to all exposed surfaces—takes about **two weeks** (roughly 10–14 days). During this period workers use scaffolding, ladders, and sometimes small helicopters to reach the higher levels, applying around 30,000 litres of paint in total.
